senses.gloss:
दृषद्वान्

DṚṢADVĀN . Father-in-law of King saṁyāti of pūru dynasty. varāṅgī was the name of Saṁyāti's wife. (See saṁyāti).

दृषद्वती

DṚṢADVATĪ . A river to the south of kurukṣetra. During their exile in the forest the pāṇḍavas drank water from it. (Vana Parva, Chapter 5, Verse 2). It was on the delta of this river that śiva imparted advice to yudhiṣṭhira. (Sabhā Parva, Chapter 78, Verse 15). Living on the northern bank of this river is equal to living in Svarga. (Vana Parva, Chapter 88). To perform bali and other rites for the souls of the dead after bathing in the river is as efficacious as performing the agniṣṭoma yajña. (Vana Parva, Chapter 88).

दृष्टकेतु

DṚṢṬAKETU . A dānava. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 67, Verse 8).
